overrides.title: Elasticsearch
overrides.note: No source has a working image. Portainer's copy pins 7.15.1 from 2021, and every other copy uses the `elasticsearch:latest` tag, which upstream does not publish. Elasticsearch ships no rolling tag at all, so a version has to be pinned and bumped by hand. Maintained in sources/local/development_templates.json.

overrides.title: Jenkins
overrides.reason: Portainer's copy pins the retired lts-jdk11 tag; this one tracks the current LTS line

overrides.title: MySQL
overrides.reason: Portainer's copy uses mysql/mysql-server:5.7, a repository Oracle retired on a release that reached end of life in October 2023
